# Settings sections open and show their content

## Area
settings

## Steps
1. Open the screen from the sidebar.
2. Read what the screen shows.
3. Check that empty parts show a plain sentence.

## Expected results
- The screen title is visible.
- Nothing changes when the page is only read.

## Data needs
- None.

## Forbidden
- Read only. Do not save, create, submit, send, delete, approve, stop or answer anything.
